testCases.query: my disk is almost full, I run a lot of agents and worktrees
expectedBehavior: Shows the inventory with SAFE, REGENERABLE and ASK FIRST sections
Asks the user to confirm before any --apply
Leads with the verdict line, then the three biggest rows and any KEEP reasons
Reports the measured freed total, not the estimate
Does not run any ASK FIRST command

testCases.query: clean up old merged worktrees but leave my caches alone
expectedBehavior: Leaves dirty, unmerged, locked and in-use worktrees in place

testCases.query: close my idle agent sessions and delete merged branches
expectedBehavior: Does not trigger disk-cleanup, it frees disk space only
Does not run a delete from the skill; Downloads is ASK FIRST and the user names the files
